title: Взвод
originalDescription: Monster platoons are highly organized and usually self-sufficient armies. Platoons are well-rounded organizations well equipped to handle most combat objectives. A single platoon creature is a decent threat to a hero of the same level, so an encounter consisting entirely of these creatures typically has one per hero. Platoon creatures often fight alongside [minions](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.organization/minion) and an [elite](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.organization/elite) creature or two to round out their ranks.
